Name: de Blob Revolution
Description: Universomo's puzzle spin-off of THQ's de Blob for Windows Phone. Draw a route for Blob through each floor of a tower block, painting it in colour and freeing the Graydians without crossing your own trail. Three building types - Rescue, Speed Rescue and INKT Chase - feed three rankings: green for care, blue for speed, orange for challenge.
